description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'TasksPage' that displays a list of tasks with filtering options, integrating data from various repositories, and handling user interactions like creating and editing tasks.

classes.name: TasksPage
classes.description: A stateful widget serving as the main UI for displaying and filtering tasks.

classes.name: _TasksPageState
classes.description: State class managing filters, building the task list, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including filters and the task list stream.

methods.name: _buildFilters
methods.description: Creates UI components for filtering tasks by status, project, and tags.

methods.name: _buildStreamList
methods.description: Builds the stream of tasks, including loading, empty state, and task list display.

methods.name: _matchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a task matches current filter criteria.

methods.name: _toggleDone
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the task creation form page.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the task editing page for a specific task.
